note: Science's account of the week after OpenAI's Navier–Stokes claim: Javier Gómez-Serrano's packed talk at Harvard, Buckmaster and Alpöge's dispute with OpenAI, the open letter against the Caltech Mathathon, the Association for Human Mathematics and the Fields Medallists' letter, and worries that unequal access to AI will divide the next generation of mathematicians.
title: OpenAI breakthrough triggers ‘existential crisis’ in math
